title: Retainer Ledger
user: Independent consultants and tradespeople who take deposits or retainers, then need to show exactly how later work draws down that money.
smallest_useful_product: An offline ledger for one job: record a deposit request, payments, approved drawdowns, and remaining balance; export a branded one-page PDF statement.
constraints: Use neutral wording such as record, preserve immutable adjustment history, and timestamp every generated statement.
